question: Which durable scope should own mixed-model Tool Search selection: an agent override, capability-driven automatic mode selection, or the requested full agent/provider matrix?
rationale: Each approach solves the reported setup but creates a different public configuration, precedence, and model-compatibility contract that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Agent-first override
options.body: Add `agents.list[].tools.toolSearch`, inherit the global value, and defer provider scope until a concrete provider-wide case is demonstrated.

options.title: Capability-driven mode
options.body: Add explicit model/provider compatibility metadata that selects a safer Tool Search surface without another agent setting.

options.title: Full override matrix
options.body: Add both agent and provider/model overrides with a documented and tested precedence order.

recommendation.title: Agent-first override
recommendation.body: Add `agents.list[].tools.toolSearch`, inherit the global value, and defer provider scope until a concrete provider-wide case is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on lean-model tool policy and the harness boundary makes this the strongest available owner for deciding whether adaptation should be configuration- or capability-driven.
